title: Valorant Ace
blurb: Five eliminations, one player, and the game stops to make sure everybody knows. Riot's ace announcement is the highest individual honour Valorant hands out, and the sting is appropriately grand — a small fanfare for a round that will be clipped, uploaded and referenced for weeks. Anyone who has held a 1v5 knows the specific silence that precedes it. Play it after any solo achievement, especially one that should have required at least two people and a plan. Also excellent when used sarcastically on somebody who did the bare minimum.
origin: The ace announcement from Valorant (Riot Games).
